data.name: Midlaj
data.gender_notes: Midlaj is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Midlaj is derived from the Arabic language. It is a name that signifies delicateness, tenderness, and gentleness. In the Quran, Allah (SWT) says, 'And indeed, you do not attain to the Good except that Allah wills for it. Allah is Knowing, Wise.' (Quran 16:37) The name Midlaj represents the gentle and caring nature of a believer, one who strives to please Allah (SWT) and uphold His teachings.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the gentle and loving nature of a believer.
data.etymology: Midlaj belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, tender, gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Midlaj total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Midlaj carries a rich cultural heritage, originating from the Arabic language. It is a beautiful and unique name that is often used in the Islamic world and among Arabs. The name signifies delicateness, tenderness, and gentleness, qualities that are highly prized in Islamic culture and the Islamic way of life.

It is a reminder of the importance of being kind and compassionate towards others, and of the need to uphold the teachings of Islam with tender and loving hearts. The name also serves as a reminder of the role of God's will in one's life, emphasizing the importance of submission and reliance on Him.
